text: Parks, Forestry and Recreation is replacing its registration and booking software in the fourth quarter of 2024. Staff presented at the January 31, 2024 meeting and received feedback from the advisory committee. The purpose of this presentation is to provide an update on the gender data collection in the registration and booking system.
Due to lack of quorum, the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee did not consider this item.
